search_surfaces_used: reference lists and forward-citation results from inspected primary papers

R01.title: Non-integrability of the n-body problem
R01.reason: Current common-level theorem explicitly leaves (H,C)=(0,0) open.

R02.title: Non integrability of the n body problem with non zero angular momentum
R02.reason: Remark 7 says the double-zero homothetic VE is integrable at all orders and requests a new explicit orbit.

R03.title: On the meromorphic non-integrability of some N-body problems
R03.reason: Ambient homothetic evidence; no fixed double-zero tangent obstruction.

R04.title: On some exceptional cases in the integrability of the three-body problem
R04.reason: Ziglin analysis uses the parabolic Lagrange homothetic orbit and does not close the fixed double-zero gap.

R05.title: Three-body problem
R05.reason: Led to periodic, free-fall, Sundman, and classical particular-solution primary sources.

R06.title: Three body problem
R06.reason: Scaling and collision-manifold overview; primary sources were inspected separately.

R07.title: Saari's Homographic Conjecture of the Three-Body Problem
R07.reason: Classifies constant-measure zero-level candidates but constructs no new orbit.

R08.title: Dynamics of the Parabolic Restricted Collinear Three-Body Problem
R08.reason: The third body is massless and the primaries are prescribed.

R09.title: Periodic three-body orbits with vanishing angular momentum in the Jacobi-Poincare strong potential
R09.reason: Uses the inverse-square strong potential, not Newtonian inverse distance.

R10.title: Classical Coulomb Three-Body Problem
R10.reason: Charged Coulomb signs and model differ from three positive Newtonian gravitating masses.

R11.title: Introduction to the N-body problem
R11.reason: Defines the H=C=0 collision manifold and records the explicit homographic boundary.

R12.title: A remarkable periodic solution of the three-body problem in the case of equal masses
R12.reason: Rigorous zero-angular-momentum periodic family; exact virial identity forces H<0.

R13.title: Symmetric Regularization, Reduction and Blow-Up of the Planar Three-Body Problem
R13.reason: Global reduction and blow-up method, but no explicit new double-zero phase curve.

R14.title: Null Angular Momentum and Weak KAM Solutions of the Newtonian N-Body Problem
R14.reason: Guarantees many exact nonhomothetic completely parabolic C=0 solutions without algebraic formulas.

R15.title: Free Time Minimizers for the Three-Body Problem
R15.reason: Provides nonhomothetic parabolic existence and asymptotic results, not an explicit algebraic orbit.

R16.title: Minimal Geodesics of the Isosceles Three Body Problem
R16.reason: Zero-energy nonhomothetic geodesics are qualitative or numerical and symmetry restricted.

R17.title: Total Collisions in the N-Body Shape Space
R17.reason: Generic total collision is an essential singularity; exceptional mass regularization is insufficient.

R18.title: Sundman theorem revisited
R18.reason: The formal equal-mass triple-collision formula is fixed-shape and released from rest, so H<0.

R19.title: A symplectic integrator for the symmetry reduced and regularised planar 3-body problem with vanishing angular momentum
R19.reason: Exact splitting method, but orbit examples are numerical and the displayed periodic cases use h=-1.

R20.title: The 1223 new periodic orbits of planar three-body problem with unequal mass and zero angular momentum
R20.reason: Numerical periodic catalogue; all collision-free periodic Newtonian candidates have H<0.

R21.title: Minlos-Faddeev regularization of zero-range interactions in the three-body problem
R21.reason: Quantum zero-range Hamiltonian, not classical Newtonian dynamics.

R22.title: Exact solution of the three-boson problem at vanishing energy

R23.title: Homoclinic orbits and oscillation for the planar three-body problem

R24.title: Regularization of simultaneous binary collisions in the n-body problem
R24.reason: States collisions of three or more bodies are not generally regularizable outside simple subclasses.

R25.title: On the meromorphic non-integrability of some N-body problems
R25.reason: Summarizes the same parabolic Lagrange ambient analyses already pinned from primary papers.

R26.title: Kinematic geometry of triangles and the study of the three-body problem
R26.reason: Studies equal-mass zero-energy triple-collision trajectories through series and geometry, not one qualifying algebraic curve.

R27.title: An extensive search for stable periodic orbits of the equal-mass zero angular momentum three-body problem
R27.reason: Numerical equal-mass periodic search; H<0 follows independently of catalogue details.

R28.title: Periodic orbits for Newtonian planar three-body problem with unequal mass
R28.reason: Numerical initial conditions and animations, not algebraic curves; periodic H<0.

R29.title: The three-body problem - The Geometry of Celestial Mechanics
R29.reason: Reviews homographic and restricted models without a new double-zero algebraic orbit.

R30.title: N-body problem
R30.reason: Virial and scaling leads were replaced by exact project derivations and primary sources.

R31.title: Three Body Problem - an overview
R31.reason: Collision-manifold overview led to McGehee-style primary sources.

R32.title: Detection of close encounters and resonances in three-body problems through Levi-Civita regularization
R32.reason: Restricted-three-body numerical regularization, not a full exact witness.

R33.title: Nonintegrability of the Armbruster-Guckenheimer-Kim Quartic Hamiltonian Through Morales-Ramis Theory
R33.reason: Quartic model unrelated to Newtonian three-body dynamics.

R34.title: Saari's homographic conjecture for general masses in planar three-body problem under Newton potential and a strong force potential
R34.reason: Classification result, not construction of a nonhomothetic algebraic phase curve.

R35.title: Total Collisions in the N-Body Shape Space

R36.title: Saari's homographic conjecture for planar equal-mass three-body problem in Newton gravity
R36.reason: Equal-mass classification result, not a new witness.

R37.title: Dynamics of the parabolic restricted three-body problem
R37.reason: Massless third body and prescribed two-body parabolic primaries.

R38.title: A Variational proof of the existence of Von Schubart's orbit
R38.reason: Two equal masses, collinear collisions, and periodic motion; exact periodic energy is negative.

R39.title: Symmetric and regularized coordinates on the plane triple collision manifold
R39.reason: Polynomial collision-manifold coordinates do not select a qualifying physical orbit.

R40.title: An Introduction to the Classical Three-Body Problem: From Periodic Solutions to Instabilities and Chaos
R40.reason: Review material led only to already-audited periodic and homographic families.
